content: EF Core concurrency: IsRowVersion() maps SQL rowversion; UPDATE/DELETE WHERE includes original token; zero rows -> DbUpdateConcurrencyException. rowversion only changes when the row itself is updated; docs give app-managed tokens (IsConcurrencyToken + set new value) as the way to control regeneration. Implication: child-only changes do not bump root rowversion unless root row is touched. Source learn.microsoft.com/ef/core/saving/concurrency.
